title: This Is Spinal Tap
tagline: Does for rock and roll what The Sound of Music did for hills.
about: A filmmaker follows England's loudest band on a 1982 American tour as the gigs shrink, the drummers keep dying and the amps go to 11.
cue: Bring out the rolls when Nigel takes on the miniature bread backstage.
faces: CHAPEL HILL, NORTH CAROLINA. US TOUR, 1982
NIGEL'S LARGE BREAD SALAMI AND PROVOLONE ROLLS
Nigel can't work the miniature bread. Big soft rolls so nothing needs folding.
CRUMBED OLIVES WITH THE PIMENTOS LEFT IN
Backstage, the olives came with no pimentos. Pimento-stuffed olives, crumbed and fried.
Nigel's a fish nut. Little cans, no bones.
NONE MORE BLACK PASTRAMI ON DARK RYE
Smell the Glove comes out none more black. Peppered pastrami, Swiss and pickles on rye.
The Shark Sandwich review ran to two words. Crisp battered flake with tartare.
The Stonehenge prop, in inches not feet. Fudgy brownie slabs stood up in a circle.
Nigel's amps go one louder, to 11. Dark rum and Coca-Cola over 11 ice cubes.
Ask for it any blacker and we can't help you.
Showtime: Bring out the rolls when Nigel takes on the miniature bread backstage.
“Have... a good... time... all the time. That's my philosophy, Marty.”
Prices subject to change. Images: TMDB.
